value: RECORDED AFTER THE FACT, 2026-08-11. This voyage did not cross the emit chokepoint: it was built at Akien's explicit direction ahead of the process ('MAKE IT LOOK LIKE THAT. YOU CAN TICKET AFTER'), so no crossing was journaled, no chart chain claims it, and no verdict artifact gated its close. What IS true is measured and listed under receipts. The honest reading: BUILT and PROVED, out of band.

code: cairn/devices/bus/shim.py — BusShim, the postman: drains the transit table on each pulse and hands each envelope to the shim of its addressee, reached through the heartbeat's published shim_for

cairn/devices/cairn/machines/bus/bus.py — undelivered() as ONE anti-join per beat for the whole system (a per-device sweep would be a query per device per second, a poll wearing a heartbeat's clothes); record_delivery() writing an append-only receipt into a sibling <table>_delivery

cairn/tools/base/shim.py — deliver() made loud: it used to return None for a shim with no device and None again for a device with no receive, and with a postman standing there a quiet None reads as a successful delivery
cairn/devices/cairn/machines/ground_loop/__main__.py — the postman hand-subscribed to the resident loop
value.commit: f9774d2 — the postman rides: mail is delivered, and the receipt is the proof
design_decisions_worth_keeping: The deliverer is the bus's own shim, not the heartbeat: ground_loop 'does NOT execute, resolve, schedule, ROUTE, or write' — that clause is the 584aa74 goof's headstone, and handing an envelope to its addressee is routing.

Delivery is an append-only receipt in a sibling table, never a column on the envelope: a RECORD channel may not be rewritten (Law 7), and create_owned_table is CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS so a new column would need a migration.

The receipt is written AFTER the device takes the envelope, so a raising receiver leaves the mail in the inbox. At-least-once is the right side to fail on — losing a record of truth is worse than delivering twice.
Findings are deduped per envelope (_reported), because undeliverable mail stays undeliverable: without it, one stuck envelope reports the identical finding once a second forever.

The bus emits, not the shim: emit is DiagnosticBase's (devices), and a shim RECEIVES breadcrumbs rather than sending them — which is also the right ownership, since the stuck message is the bus's fact.
value.filed_edge: The drain is asked on a cadence because the beat is what exists today. The event-shaped answer is the store telling the postman a row landed (Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY through db_domain's gate), turning one query per second into zero queries until there is mail. It waits on real volume and on db_domain growing a listen face — its owner's call, not the bus's.
value.live_fire: 2026-08-11 against the real bus: the first drain reported 2x no_shim ('dave') and 1x no_receiver (harbor_master), and the resident loop was restarted to pick up the postman (pid 3887729, 'bus' first on the roster). Every finding it reported was true.
value.proofs_run_green_twice: ground_loop 21, discovery 12, bus 6, delivery 10, shim 7 = 56 teeth; the five librarian proofs green beside them
value.what_the_proof_killed: The bench gate this same session shipped with. _refresh_bench stat'd the trouble DIRECTORY's mtime, but trouble._write rewrites the ticket file IN PLACE — no temp, no rename — so a clear never moves that mtime and a benched device would have stayed benched forever while every surface reported a healthy beat. Replaced by an entry fingerprint (name, mtime, size per .json), and pinned by a tooth that asserts the directory mtime is UNCHANGED across the clear so the tooth cannot pass by accident.
